fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix's 2027 EPS guidance remains around KRW 530,000, but target prices from securities firms vary by up to KRW 800,000—IBK Securities KRW 3.2 million, NH Investment & Securities KRW 3.4 million, SK Securities KRW 4 million.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite IBK Securities raising EPS guidance by 12.3%, it cut its target price by 20% (KRW 4 million → KRW 3.2 million), applying a 6x PER and considering the gap with the current stock price.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK Hynix announced a shareholder return plan of approximately KRW 100 trillion (dividends of at least KRW 30 trillion, share buybacks and cancellations of at least KRW 60 trillion), with upside to target price from current levels of IBK 109.7%, NH 122.8%, and SK 162.1%.
